summary.text: Gary Boswell is a Republican state senator from Kentucky who has represented District 8 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Boswell's career experience includes owning a business and working in real estate development, and he has been affiliated with the Daviess County Farm Bureau and Owensboro Right to Life.
He took office in the Kentucky State Senate on January 1, 2023, succeeding Matt Castlen.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him on the Senate Appropriations and Revenue, Economic Development, Tourism and Labor, Agriculture (vice chair), Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection, and Natural Resources and Energy committees.
